target_customer: Local, state and federal law enforcement agencies and prosecutors
problem: Detectives face large volumes of digital evidence; Closure transcribes, translates, searches and analyzes case evidence to surface leads for human review.
business_model: B2B and government SaaS, sold via Carahsoft; pricing not stated
product_category: AI digital analyst for law enforcement

founders.name: Aaron Zelinger
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page

founders.name: Gilad Levy
prior_employers: Israeli Air Force (6 years, pilot and cybersecurity)

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal evidence processing (audio, video, documents, translation) with search and analysis, plus security needs for law enforcement data.

defensibility.rationale: Government procurement, CJIS style security and agency adoption (Anchorage Police Department per a profile) are slow to win but also slow to displace.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A profile lists these as market participants; no copying or acquisition of Closure found.

market_need_then: Police face digital evidence overload; Axios in January 2026 covered AI in detective work and cold cases with the CEO quoted.

branding.domain_note: Uses closure-intel.com; closure.ai belongs to an unrelated Closure AI trademark filer

identity.voice_and_tone: Serious, mission driven; tagline We help law enforcement solve crime

branding.community_and_virality: Axios coverage in January 2026 mentioned the company and CEO.

brand_strength.rationale: Closure evokes case closure and suits the buyers, but the generic word collides with other firms such as Closure AI Inc.

outcome_analysis: Closure is a Winter 2025 New York company with a Palantir veteran CEO and a CTO from Israeli cyber and enterprise software. It has agency adoption, a Carahsoft listing and Axios coverage, with a team of 11 per YC. Funding is not verified. It is active with no exit.
notes: Company site returned 403 on fetch after a www redirect, so the site is live but unread. VCBacked and Startupintros list 500K in March 2025 (pre-seed or seed); unverified aggregators, not recorded as a round. ZeroG lists 1.9M including a 2022 Series A, likely a different company, ignored. Competitors Axon, Cellebrite and Mark43 come from an undated profile so are not listed. Location varies between sources; YC says New York.
